review.rationale: Decision preserves the original preflight failure (failure_preserved=true, no reclassification), authorizes exactly one corrected non-mutating preflight with direct SHA resolution, and gates all unconsumed draft/merge mutations on that preflight passing. Caps remain at 1 for each mutation with zero consumed. No silent retry, GitHub review/comment, branch deletion, admin/auto/squash/rebase, reset, force-push, revert, release, deployment, or status elevation is authorized. Standing directive TITMAS-CS-STANDING-001 applies within its bounded scope and does not override explicit false boundaries. All required top-level keys are present and consistent with the response contract.
